4c525bbc-0cda-4fba-a413-ed21e071224a/Eve.en: "Let the wind be my horse, the clouds my saddle,<NL>treading the world through spring's second month.<NL>Why reckon where the journey leads?<NL>I sing as I walk, I roam as I please, delighting in the moment..."<NL><NL>As a crisp song drifts through the air,<NL>one of the people of Wanqu arrive before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> without notice.<NL>He sways as he clasp his fists and bow in a festive greeting,<NL>then pulls a robe from his pocket and hands it to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

2a0b9b0c-4f75-47e3-88fb-4db855d5c8e6/Eve.en: "On this joyous occasion, with spring in full bloom,<NL>my companions and I have made this garment especially for you.<NL>May your days ahead be smooth and unimpeded. May all your journeys arrive, and all your wishes come true!"<NL><NL>After speaking, he lifts his hands and waves his sleeves,<NL>as though spurring a horse onward,<NL>and in a moment, he disappears from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s view...
